description:
Search properties still on an official tax sale / sheriff sale list. `state`: two-letter code or name;
        `county`: optional county name (e.g. "Horry"; New York City boroughs by county: "Kings" for Brooklyn);
        `sort`: sale_date_asc, sale_date_desc, amount_desc or amount_asc; `page_number` from 1, `per_page` 1 to 100.

        Each row: case or certificate number, parcel id, property address, owner (people as initials, businesses as
        recorded), sale type and date, the amount as the office labels it (opening bid, judgment, taxes due; some lists
        publish none), appraised value where given, status and the official list URL. Rows leave the list when the
        office removes them (paid, redeemed, sold, cancelled). Before bidding, a title search on the parcel shows the
        other liens and mortgages of record: order_title_search where the county is covered.

        Free preview: this tool returns the first 10 rows of each county's list (page_number above 1 is empty) with the
        county's true `total_rows`; the full list and the CSV need a free account made by entering an email on the county
        page (the `message` field says so). Summaries are complete.
name: tax_sale_search
